extra-argentina-ieshiva-anoji.name: Ieshiva Anoji
extra-argentina-ieshiva-anoji.note: 'Farbrenguen por el 20 de av e inauguración de Yeshiva Anoji - 27 de Julio del 2013 - 21 de Menajem Av del 5773. En el nuevo edificio del Beit Jabad Central, sito en Agüero 1146 ... se realizó la inauguración espiritual del lugar, donde a partir de la ocasión, funcionará la Primera Yeshivá para baal teshuvá en Latinoamérica, “Anojí” ... el Rab. Eli Srugo, Director de la nueva Yeshivá' (Periodismo Kosher, July 2013). Not on chabad.org.

7054751.name: Beit Chabad Paternal
7054751.note: 'Welcome the Newest Chabad Emissaries to Buenos Aires: Rabbi Shauli and Devora Polichenco. The Paternal neighborhood of Buenos Aires is a ... Founded by Rabbi Shauli and Devorah Polichenco exactly one year ago, Beit Chabad Paternal serves as a growing center for Jewish connection' (Chabad.org's post, also on its Facebook page; read in search excerpts). The post is of 9 June 2026 (the date its Instagram ID gives; checked on three posts of known date), so founded about June 2025, Sivan 5785. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2025-11-26.

5680309.name: Beit Jabad Tigre
5680309.note: 'Rabbi and Mrs. Yaakov Abudraham, Tigre, Argentina' among the sixty 'New Shluchim' grants announced at the Kinus Hashluchim of 5783 (CrownHeights.info, 19 Nov 2022): new shluchim in 2022 (medium: the grants go to couples in their first year or so). Its chabad.org listing went up on 2022-11-11. Vito Dumas 173, Tigre.

120138.name: Tzivos Hashem
120138.note: Tzivos Hashem (Tzivot Hashem), Jabad Argentina's children's club, directed by Rabbi Israel Kapeluschnik in 2010 (Jabad Argentina's list; Chabadpedia: from 5760 he ran Tzivos Hashem). No start found. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22, so by 2004.

119822.name: Oholey Chinuch Preschool
119822.note: The Oholey Jinuj preschool (gan): its new building in the former Dr. Herzl school, Tucumán 3177, opened in June 2012 (Itón Gadol). No start found. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22, so by 2004.

119909.name: Beit Hakneset Beit Menachem
119909.note: The Beit Menachem shul of the Chabad community, Boulogne Sur Mer 626, with the girls' school (Itón Gadol, May 2017: 'el templo Beis Menajem/Escuela Oholey Jinuj'); Rabbi Yosef Feigelstock, the community's rav since 5749 (Chabadpedia). No start found. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22, so by 2004.

119910.name: Iarjo Jabad Lavalle
119910.note: Iarjo Jabad Lavalle, Lavalle 3934, Rabbi Rafael Lapidus (1954-2023; Chabadpedia: after kollel he went out on shlichus in Buenos Aires, no year). No start found. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22, so by 2004.

159448.name: Beit Jabad Centro
159448.note: The Córdoba annex 'ANEXO BEIT JABAD CENTRO, 25 de Mayo 18, oficina 36, Centro de Córdoba' (Jabad Argentina's list, 2010). No start found. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-08-10, so by 2004.

216500.name: Soup Kitchen
216500.note: A soup kitchen in the capital with no staff on its listing; which of Chabad's kitchens it is is not known. No start found. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-10-27, so by 2004.

477080.name: Beis Chabad Palermo Soho
477080.note: Beit Jabad Palermo Soho (Rabbi Tzvi and Rivka Lipinski), Malabia 2180: 'The 27th Chabad House in Buenos Aires, Argentina, will be inaugurated Thursday' (COLlive, 19 Aug 2009) was its new building ('A dos años de la inauguración de su nueva sede', jabad.tv, June 2011); its listing was already up in Feb 2007. No start found. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2007-02-14, so by 2007.

477093.name: Anexo Templo Etz Hajaim - Jabad
477093.note: 'ANEXO TEMPLO ETZ HAJAIM – JABAD, Rabino: Iejiel Frenkel, Julián Álvarez 745' (Jabad Argentina's list, 2010): the annex of Beit Jabad Villa Crespo. No start found. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2007-02-14, so by 2007.

477125.name: Beit Jabad Once - Litvische Shul
477125.note: Beit Jabad Once – Litvische Shul, J. E. Uriburu 348: in 2010 its director was Rabbi Aharón Stawsky (Jabad Argentina's list; he died in 2012, jabad.tv). No start found. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2007-02-14, so by 2007.

588981.name: Jabad Palermo Nuevo
588981.note: 'BEIT JABAD PALERMO NUEVO, Director: Rabino Mendy Grunblatt, Buschiazo 3028' (Jabad Argentina's list). Its listing went up on 2007-11-01. No start found. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2007-11-01, so by 2007.

604253.name: Books & Judaica Showrooom
604253.note: Kehot's showroom: 'KEHOT LUBAVITCH SUDAMERICANA – SHOWROOM & JUDAICA, Cabrera 3102 (esq. Agüero)' (Jabad Argentina's list, 2010). No start found. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2007-12-28, so by 2007.

1473349.name: Centro Medico Maimonides
1473349.note: Tucumán's Centro Médico Maimónides, Lamadrid 623 (with the mikvah; AMIA's Vaad Hakehilot directory); Chabadpedia: Rabbi Daniel Levy built kindergartens, a Chabad medical center and more, no year. No start found. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2011-03-29, so by 2011.

3481780.name: Beis Chabad Barrio Norte - Aguero
3481780.note: Beis Chabad Barrio Norte - Agüero (Mrs. Freidi Grunblatt). No start found. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2016-11-02, so by 2016.

3835668.name: Jabad Nordelta
3835668.note: JCC Jabad Nordelta (Rabbi Boruch Hagman, who managed Beit Jabad Almagro's areas in 2014, Itón Gadol); Boulevard del Mirador 106, Nordelta. No start found. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2017-11-03, so by 2017.

3922564.name: Beis Chabad Chacarita
3922564.note: Beit Jabad Chacarita, Céspedes 3550 (Rabbi Yechezkel and Shifra Wildau; she died on 25 Iyar 5785, Esencia 50): 'Nueva comunidad Judía de Chacarita' (its Facebook page). No start found. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2018-01-29, so by 2018.

3637163.name: Beit Chabad Caballito Sur
3637163.note: Beit Chabad Caballito Sur (Rabbi Shloime Setton): Caballito's annex at Bertres 339 (Jabad Argentina's list). No start found. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2019-09-12, so by 2019.

6257747.name: Beit Jabad Pilar
6257747.note: Beit Jabad Pilar (Rabbi Moishe and Michal Brand). No start found. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2024-01-16, so by 2024.

6294766.name: Beit Jabad Bajo Belgrano
6294766.note: Beit Jabad Bajo Belgrano, Castañeda 1871, Golf Square (Rabbi Dovid and Sheyne Sara Grunblatt). No start found. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2024-01-25, so by 2024.

6620858.name: ISEJ Belgrano-Jabad
6620858.note: ISEJ Belgrano, O'Higgins 2358 (Jabad Argentina's list): the old Beit Jabad Belgrano's address (Rabbi Shlomo Kiesel; 'Establecido: Elul 5747 – Septiembre de 1987', Jabad Argentina's 2010 list; under a government intervention in 2022, Itón Gadol). ISEJ itself opened in 2006. No start found for this branch. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2025-06-09, so by 2025.

extra-argentina-vicente-lopez.name: Beit Jabad Vicente López
extra-argentina-vicente-lopez.note: Beit Jabad Vicente López (Rabbi Menachem Mendel Kapelushnik, Chabadpedia). Not in Jabad Argentina's older lists (2010, about 2016); in today's (jabad.org.ar/centros). No start found; by 2026. Not on chabad.org.

extra-argentina-avellaneda.name: Beit Iaacov
extra-argentina-avellaneda.note: Beit Iaacov, Florencio Varela 151, Avellaneda. Not in Jabad Argentina's older lists (2010, about 2016); in today's (jabad.org.ar/centros). No start found; by 2026. Not on chabad.org.

extra-argentina-yerba-buena.name: Beit Jabad Kehilá de Yerba Buena
extra-argentina-yerba-buena.note: Beit Jabad Kehilá de Yerba Buena, Av. Aconquija 1071 (Tucumán). Not in Jabad Argentina's older lists (2010, about 2016); in today's (jabad.org.ar/centros). No start found; by 2026. Not on chabad.org.

extra-argentina-belgrano-beit-menajem.name: Jabad Beit Menajem Belgrano
extra-argentina-belgrano-beit-menajem.note: Jabad Beit Menajem Belgrano, Olazábal 2287. Not in Jabad Argentina's older lists (2010, about 2016); in today's (jabad.org.ar/centros). No start found; by 2026. Not on chabad.org.

118440.name: Beis Chabad Recoleta
118440.note: 'BEIT JABAD RECOLETA. Director: Rabino Hirshel Hendel. Establecido: 2-3-2001. Ayacucho 1416' (Jabad Argentina's own list of its centers ('Batei Jabad en Argentina y en el mundo': its old site, kept at archivo.jabad.org.ar/batei-jabad, and the July 2010 copy on the Wayback Machine)). 2-3-2001 is 2 March 2001 (7 Adar 5761) the Argentine way, or 3 February (Yud Shevat 5761): either is 5761, so no day entered. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2004-07-22. 'For 25 years, Rabbi Hirshel and Suri Hendel have lovingly served the Recoleta neighborhood'; their son Rabbi Mendy and Tzivie Hendel joined them (Chabad.org, copied by CrownHeights.info, 17 Feb 2026).
